## Summary

Describe the smallest user-visible or contract-level change.

## Verification

- [ ] Catalog validation passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and generated projections are synchronized where affected.

## Boundaries

- [ ] I added no secrets, private prompts, personal paths, or unrelated logs.
- [ ] I documented any security, privacy, compatibility, method-claim, or evidence impact.
- [ ] I retained FAIL, ERROR, INCOMPLETE, correlation, dissent, and unknown states.
- [ ] I described skipped checks and what they leave unverified.
